u-ssi-1id.page: 1st Infantry Division Big Red One, US Army
facts: Design: a red numeral "1" on an olive drab shield, about 2 1/2 in. wide by 3 3/4 in. tall.
Originally approved 31 October 1918 as a red "1" for the 1st Division; amended 31 March 1927 to add the background; redesignated for the 1st Infantry Division 19 August 1942.

u-ssi-25id.page: 25th Infantry Division Tropic Lightning, US Army
facts: Design: a red taro leaf, stem up, about 2 7/8 in. high, with a 1/8 in. yellow border and a yellow lightning flash.
The taro leaf recalls the division's descent from the Hawaiian Division; the lightning flash stands for how it carries out its assignments.
Division organized 1 October 1914 at Schofield Barracks, Hawaii and activated 26 August 1941; insignia authorized 25 September 1944 (per the page).
